title: Tesla says customers can add their own vehicles to the robotaxi fleet next year — will it happen?

claims.claim: Tesla, arac sahiplerinin otomobillerini robotaksi agina dahil etmesi icin 2027 yili ikinci ceyregini hedef olarak belirledi.

evidence.quote: Tesla has set a Q2 2027 target to let owners opt their cars into its robotaxi network—a major promise, but one that comes with a history of missed deadlines and steep regulatory hurdles.

claims.claim: Otonom Surus Baskan Yardimcisi Ashok Elluswamy, musterilerin araclarini 2027'nin ikinci ceyreginde sirketin robotaksi filosuna ekleyebilecegini belirtti.

evidence.quote: According to Tesla VP for Autonomous Driving Ashok Elluswamy, Tesla owners will be able to add their own vehicles to the company’s robotaxi fleet in the second quarter of 2027.

claims.claim: Elon Musk 2019 yilindaki AI Day etkinlikte, musteri araclarinin robotaksi olarak kullanilacagini ve 2020 yilina kadar bir milyon Tesla robotaksinin yollarda olacagini soylemisti.
Tesla'nin su anda Teksas ve Florida'da bazilarinda insan guvenlik monitoru bulunan birkaç yuz robotaksi bulunuyor.

evidence.quote: Tesla has a few hundred Robotaxis in Texas and Florida, some of which still have human safety monitors.

claims.claim: Sirketin Austin'de birkaç duzine tamamen surucusuz Cybercab'i bulunuyor.

evidence.quote: It also has several dozen fully driverless Cybercabs in Austin.

claims.claim: Kuzey Amerika'da yeni Tesla alanlarin yuzde 75'inden fazlasi bu ceyrekte Full Self-Driving Supervised ozelligini secti.

evidence.quote: Over 75 percent of new buyers picked the feature this quarter — a big jump of almost 20 percentage points compared to last quarter.

claims.claim: Tesla yeni Robotaxi guvenlik web sitesinde 3,3 milyon mili otonom olarak katettigini acikladi.

evidence.quote: Tesla also revealed a new Robotaxi safety website, in which the company says it has driven 3.3 million miles autonomously.

claims.claim: Sirket Temmuz ayinda denetimsiz olarak 380.000 mil suruldugunu bildirmisti.

evidence.quote: That’s up from 380,000 unsupervised miles driven the company reported in July.
